info.name: Solaris Zones Oracle Solaris Kernel Zones Archive Creation Resources API

params.name: zoneName
params.description: Name of the zone to configure

items.docs: Retrieve resources configured for the zone, optionally filtered by resource type and property values. Returns an array of Resource objects with their properties.

info.name: Solaris Zones Add a Resource to Zone Configuration

params.name: zoneName
params.description: Name of the zone to configure

items.docs: Add a new resource to the zone configuration. Must be called within an editing session (after editConfig). The resource is staged until commitConfig is called.

info.name: Solaris Zones Remove Resources From Zone Configuration

params.name: zoneName
params.description: Name of the zone to configure

items.docs: Remove resources matching the specified filter from the zone configuration. Must be called within an editing session.

info.name: Solaris Zones Get Properties of a Zone Resource

params.name: zoneName
params.description: Name of the zone to configure

items.docs: Retrieve specific properties from a zone resource identified by type and filter criteria.

info.name: Solaris Zones Set Properties on a Zone Resource

params.name: zoneName
params.description: Name of the zone to configure

items.docs: Set property values on a zone resource identified by type and filter criteria. Must be called within an editing session.

info.name: Solaris Zones Clear Properties on a Zone Resource

params.name: zoneName
params.description: Name of the zone to configure

items.docs: Clear (reset to default) property values on a zone resource. Must be called within an editing session.
